mapper.select: SELECT IPHTML_NO, IPROM_NO, SITEM, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSEARCH_TEXT, SSYS_ID FROM TB_PROV_HTML WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} ORDER BY SITEM

SELECT H.IPHTML_NO, H.IPROM_NO, H.SITEM, H.STITLE, H.SCONTENTS, H.SREASON, H.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, H.SDISP_YN, H.SSTART_DT, H.SINS_DT, H.SSEARCH_TEXT, H.SSYS_ID FROM TB_PROV_HTML H, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT H2.IPHTML_NO FROM TB_PROV_HTML H2, ( SELECT PR2.IPROM_NO, PH.SITEM FROM TB_PROM PR2, ( SELECT MAX(P2.ILAW_NO) AS LAW_NO, H3.SITEM AS SITEM FROM TB_PROM P2, TB_PROV_HTML H3 WHERE P2.IPROM_NO = H3.IPROM_NO AND P2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND P2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND NVL(H3.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(P2.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY H3.SITEM ) PH WHERE PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO = PH.LAW_NO ) PRD WHERE H2.IPROM_NO = PRD.IPROM_NO AND H2.SITEM = PRD.SITEM ) H_MAX WHERE H.IPHTML_NO = H_MAX.IPHTML_NO AND H.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND NVL(H.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY H.SITEM ASC

SELECT H.IPHTML_NO, H.IPROM_NO, H.SITEM, H.STITLE, H.SCONTENTS, H.SREASON, H.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, H.SDISP_YN, H.SSTART_DT, H.SINS_DT, H.SSEARCH_TEXT, H.SSYS_ID FROM TB_PROV_HTML H, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT H2.IPHTML_NO FROM TB_PROV_HTML H2, ( SELECT PR2.IPROM_NO, PH.SITEM FROM TB_PROM PR2, ( SELECT MAX(P2.ILAW_NO) AS LAW_NO, H3.SITEM AS SITEM FROM TB_PROM P2, TB_PROV_HTML H3 WHERE P2.IPROM_NO = H3.IPROM_NO AND P2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND P2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} GROUP BY H3.SITEM ) PH WHERE PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO = PH.LAW_NO ) PRD WHERE H2.IPROM_NO = PRD.IPROM_NO AND H2.SITEM = PRD.SITEM ) H_MAX WHERE H.IPHTML_NO = H_MAX.IPHTML_NO AND H.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND ( NVL(H.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' OR ( H.SDISP_YN = 'N' AND PR.ILAW_NO = #{lawNo} ) ) ORDER BY H.SITEM ASC
SELECT IPHTML_NO, IPROM_NO, SITEM, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSEARCH_TEXT, SSYS_ID FROM TB_PROV_HTML WHERE IPHTML_NO = #{provHtmlNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PROV_HTML ( IPHTML_NO, IPROM_NO, SITEM, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSEARCH_TEXT ) VALUES ( #{provHtmlNo}, #{promNo}, #{item}, #{title}, #{contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{gaejungType}, NVL(#{dispYn}, 'Y'), NVL(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), #{searchText,jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROV_HTML SET SITEM = #{item}, STITLE = #{title}, SCONTENTS = #{contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, SREASON = #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, SGAEJUNG_TYPE = #{gaejungType}, SDISP_YN = NVL(#{dispYn}, SDISP_YN), SSTART_DT = NVL(#{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SSTART_DT), SSEARCH_TEXT = #{searchText,jdbcType=CLOB} WHERE IPHTML_NO = #{provHtmlNo}
